Package com.project.cooking.finance

Class Invoice

java.lang.Object
com.project.cooking.finance.Invoice
public class Invoice extends Object
The Invoice class represents an invoice for a customer purchase. It includes details about the invoice number, customer name, items purchased, price, taxes, and the transaction date. This class also calculates the total amount of the invoice.

abood
